mostWorthwhile.text: Examining the prepared membrane was most worthwhile: the visible joints turned an ordinary water-system failure into a consequential discovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the residue directly at the microscope was less worthwhile because it failed without explaining why membrane preparation was needed.

surprise.text: The curled flecks proved to include a segmented body with limbs, rather than simply sediment.

arbitrary.text: Requiring a membrane before microscopy initially felt arbitrary, although the subsequent rinse showed how it separated the flecks.

continue.text: Yes. I would want to see how Earth responds and whether the body’s origin can be established; the backflush and filtering also gave the discovery a plausible investigative sequence.
